subject: Discovery recap & next steps: Redwood for FinPath

Subject: Discovery recap & next steps: Redwood for FinPath

Hi Alex / Morgan,

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to understand FinPath's priorities around latency-sensitive customer-facing features and tighter cost controls as you scale. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key needs we heard: low-latency chat for support flows, predictable cost per 1k tokens, private deployment options for sensitive PII.
- Constraints: procurement timeline (targeting vendor selection by end of Q4), security questionnaire (they use internal SOC2 checklist), and a demo that includes a technical deep dive for your platform team.

Proposed next step: a 60-minute technical deep dive + Ops Q&A where we can cover architecture, quantization/throughput tradeoffs, and security controls. I can do Tue 10/13 11:00-12:00 PT or Wed 10/14 09:00-10:00 PT — let me know what works or send a couple slots and I’ll coordinate.

Looping in Neha (SE) and Vivek (security) to join the deep dive and prep any collateral. I’ve attached a short Security Overview and our commercial checklist to help procurement.

Attachments: Redwood-Security-Overview.pdf, Redwood-Commercial-Checklist.xlsx

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
